item.title: Our Approach to Bioresilience: Isomorphic Labs and Google DeepMind
item.description:
📝 The global biosecurity landscape is rapidly evolving. We need frontier AI models, and the scientific advances they will enable, to respond to these challenges and help make society more resilient to events like future outbreaks. Over the past 12 months, we have advanced more than 15 partnerships with government bodies, biosecurity organizations, and research groups to prevent threat actors from misusing our models, detect new outbreaks quickly and respond quickly and effectively.
🔗 Read more: https://deepmind.google/blog/our-approach-to-bioresilience/
